messages: Marta: Quick sync 10m: debating required marker and inline error timing for the dense Create Pool form. also need a clear rule for delete confirmations (list vs detail). Eli: For dense rows, prefer a lightweight asterisk visually but include sr-only 'Required' text for screen readers. Full 'Required' label when space permits. Aisha: Accessibility note: always set `aria-required=\"true\"` on required controls and include `aria-describedby` pointing to the error node. if we use an asterisk, add `Required` not just CSS title. Sam: Error timing: format/constraint validation on blur (email, number), missing/required only after submit attempt. Blur errors are noisy for requiredness. Lee: Implementation detail: on submit fail, focus-first-invalid and expand any collapsed panels containing errors. announce via SR: \"Submission failed. Section X expanded. Focus moved to first error.\" Use `aria-live=\"assertive\"` for banners, `polite` for blur hints. Marta: Delete pattern: list view = compact modal with checkbox + undo toast. detail view = typed-confirm when pool has active deployments or prod tag. include resource summary (deploys, machines). Eli: Copy for typed confirm modal suggestion: Permanently delete pool \"analytics-prod\"? This will remove data and stop active deployments. Type the pool name to confirm: `analytics-prod` Keep input if mismatch, show inline error \"Pool name does not match.\" and don't clear. Aisha: Also announce modal open: `aria-live` message \"Confirm delete: analytics-prod\" and trap focus with `aria-modal=\"true\"`. if mismatch announce error with `role=\"alert\"`. Sam: UX rule summary I'll follow: format checks on blur, required missing after submit, list deletes = checkbox modal + undo, detail deletes = typed-confirm for prod/non-empty. Marta: Action items: 1) update spec with these timing rules and a11y snippets; 2) component lib: focus-first-invalid util + aria-describedby examples; 3) copy PR for typed-confirm + screenshot mocks. design-bot: Summary added to docs/design/create-pool-required-and-delete-guidelines.md (draft). Marta: Thanks — I'll open the PR and tag for review tomorrow.
